description:
QSIG geopolitical risk score (0-100, higher = more risk), with 24h
    change, 30/90-day percentile rank, regime label and event count.

    Returns the current score, or a historical one if as_of is given.
    as_of is an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp such as "2026-09-15T12:00:00Z"; the
    most recent observation at or before it is returned, with
    match_offset_seconds showing how far back the match was. History begins
    2026-09-09 and is sampled every ~15 minutes, so earlier timestamps
    return an error rather than a score.

    This is a MEASURED STATE, not a forecast. No directional or predictive
    claim is made. Paid route: $0.02 USDC via x402. Call get_track_record
    first if you want to evaluate the service before paying.
name: get_georisk
